sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Reservations"."Room" AS e, "Rooms"."bedType" AS g, SUM("Reservations"."Kids") AS m1 FROM "Reservations" JOIN "Rooms" ON "Rooms"."RoomId" = "Reservations"."Room"  GROUP BY "Reservations"."Room", "Rooms"."bedType"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "s3"."g" ORDER BY "s3"."m1" DESC) AS r FROM "s3") SELECT "s4"."e" AS e, "s4"."g" AS g, "s4"."m1" AS m1, "s4"."m2" AS m2, "s4"."r" AS r FROM "s4" WHERE "s4"."r" <= 3
why: total of number of children per Rooms within Rooms.bedType (additive)
share of the all total of total of number of children (all level)
rank within the group by total of number of children, keep the top 3

why: average of nightly rate charged per Rooms within Rooms.bedType
index against the all average of average of nightly rate charged (all level)
rank within the group by average of nightly rate charged, keep the top 3
